units.source_text: 正如七段所说，黑101下在连我们都知道的地方。

en.t: As the seventh-dan player said, Black 101 was played at a point even we could understand.

units.source_text: 棋局已经进入收官阶段，是黑子应该侵入右下角白模样的时候了，黑101只能落在这好点上。

en.t: The game had already entered the endgame, and it was time for Black to invade White's framework in the lower right corner, so Black 101 could only be played on this vital point.

units.source_text: 除了跳到“18·十三”的101位之外，还有一手“18·十二”爬，即使犹豫不决，其变化也可以料到。

en.t: Besides jumping to the 101 point at "18-13," there was also the move of crawling at "18-12"; even if one hesitated, the resulting variations could be foreseen.
